cohort: 654 late preterm infants delivered at Sidra Medicine between 1st January 2018 and 29th February 2024.
finding: Antenatal steroid exposure showed no significant protective effect against respiratory distress, but was associated with an increased risk of hypoglycemia and prolonged NICU stay in late preterm infants.
gest_age: Late preterm (implied 34 weeks 0 days to 36 weeks 6 days of gestation)
